title: Scenario Library: Hosted API + Model Catalog — Runway Stress Tests & OKR Alignment
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a curated Scenario Library that pairs hosted API demand lanes with model-catalog commitments to inform Q2 roadmap decisions. The library is intended to: 1) provide deterministic guidance for capacity hedging and canary windows across model tiers; 2) map OKR-level success metrics to concrete runway scenarios (e.g., 2x surge, model degradation, region outage); and 3) produce a small set of recommended tranche plans that PMs, Eng, and SREs can execute during the quarter. This ticket scopes the planning artifact, stakeholder review loop, and initial set of 6 canonical scenarios with runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: A consolidated Scenario Library doc exists in Confluence with 6 canonical scenarios and decision criteria
Runway recommendation matrix (capacity vs. model tier) completed and reviewed by Eng and SRE
Canary calendar proposals for model swaps and rotations scheduled for Q2 staging windows
OKR mappings: each scenario tied to measurable OKR metrics and observability dashboards
Stakeholder sign-off from runtime, capacity, and growth leads recorded in the doc
